verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Asana's API/integrations let other apps create Asana tasks or embed components, but there is no evidence of a unified view that aggregates an engineer's assigned tasks from multiple different project-management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) inside Asana itself. Missing for 10: any documentation of a cross-tool task aggregation/unified inbox feature, evidence of pulling in tasks from other PM tools, or a 'My Tasks' view spanning external systems.
